testCommand: S="$(mktemp -d)"; mkdir -p "$S/home" "$S/tmp"; env -i PATH="$(dirname "$(command -v node)"):/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin" HOME="$S/home" TMPDIR="$S/tmp" NODE_OPTIONS="--require=$PWD/harness/loopback-only.cjs" PRISMA_ROOT="$PWD" REPO_PATH="$PWD" node harness/run-tests.js scripts "$PWD"/{files}; rc=$?; rm -rf "$S"; exit $rc
baseSetup: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --prefix scripts && npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --prefix dashboard
